FN-C4UBWQW-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 210
Committee: Veterans, Military Affairs, and Public Safety Sponsor: Senator Rodger Smitherman
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/07/2024
Senate Bill 210 as introduced provides for the state to establish concurrent jurisdiction with the
United States for certain criminal offenses committed by juveniles on military installation within
the state.
This could increase the obligations of the Unified Judicial System and certain counties, by an
undetermined amount, dependent upon the number of cases that are adjudicated in juvenile
court as a result of the establishment of concurrent jurisdiction, which could be offset, in whole
or in part, dependent upon whether the juvenile court orders a parent or other person legally
obligated to care or support a child.
